The '''Cornesia system''' was located in the [[Manda sector/Legends|Manda sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the material known as [[Cornesian Wax|Cornesian wax]].<ref name="BH">[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Bounty Hunter'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Cornesian Wax|Cornesian wax]]|system=Cornesia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cornesia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was established in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square R-14.<ref name="TEA" />
